name: BWX Technologies
description: US nuclear manufacturer from Lynchburg, Virginia building both the US Department of Defense's Project Pele 1-5 MWe transportable microreactor and the TRISO-fuelled BANR HTGR (75 MWt / 22 MWe), selected for a Canadian transportable nuclear power plant targeting service in the early 2030s.
